posts.title: CrowdStrike Incident - Lessons Learned and Discourse Initiated
posts.description: On July 19, 2024, CrowdStrike released a sensor configuration update to Windows systems that triggered a logic error resulting in a system crash and blue screen (BSOD) on affected systems. The incident impacted worldwide infrastructure in industry as critical as hospitals, airlines, and finance. It resulted in a direct impact on human lives. People were returned from the emergency room in hospital
